::: {#def-identical-relational-distributions .theorem}
## Identical relational distributions

A bipartite [graph generator](#def-npsem-ge) with [local tie formation](#def-local-tie-formation) has identical relational distributions if every [dyad](#def-dyad) has the same relational equation $f_{\boldsymbol\psi}$ and the same error distribution:

$$
U_{ij} \sim U_{i'j'} \qquad \text{for all } i, i' \in \mathcal P,\ j, j' \in \mathcal Q.
$$
:::
